title: Unwired-dispatch zero-debt value leak: default empty hook accrues no phUSD debt if owner forgets setHook (Law-3 footgun)
channel: main (Medium) — operational hazard / Law-3 non-obvious footgun
description: ATokenDispatcherV2's constructor (line 51) defaults `hook = new DefaultDispatchHook()`, an empty no-op hook. NudgeRatchet inherits this dispatch path: _dispatch (NudgeRatchet.sol:60) forwards the USDC `amount` to the batchMinter and invokes hook.onDispatch, but DefaultDispatchHook.onDispatch (line 12) does nothing. If the owner deploys NudgeRatchet plus NudgeRatchetMintDebtHook but forgets `dispatcher.setHook(nudgeHook)`, every dispatch forwards USDC to the batchMinter while accruing ZERO phUSD mint-debt. There is no revert, no event, and no backfill path to recover the un-accrued debt after the fact. This is a non-obvious Law-3 footgun (in scope per the three-law hierarchy): a competent, non-malicious owner would be surprised that dispatches silently succeed with no debt accrual when the hook is unwired. The project's own integration test NudgeRatchet.t.sol:160-182 exercises this exact path WITHOUT calling setHook and asserts only the USDC flow — so the silent zero-debt path passes the test suite undetected.
impact: Value leak / protocol-function loss: USDC is forwarded to the batchMinter while the corresponding phUSD mint-debt is never recorded, with no on-chain signal (no revert/event) and no retroactive backfill. Direction fails safe re: phUSD solvency (no unbacked mint), but the protocol's intended debt-accounting is silently skipped for the entire unwired window. Bounded by operator config but non-obvious and not self-correcting; Medium as a value-leak operational hazard with an external (mis)configuration requirement.
attackPath: Owner deploys ATokenDispatcherV2/NudgeRatchet; constructor defaults hook = DefaultDispatchHook (no-op).
Owner deploys NudgeRatchetMintDebtHook but forgets dispatcher.setHook(nudgeHook).
Users/keeper trigger dispatches; _dispatch forwards USDC to batchMinter and calls DefaultDispatchHook.onDispatch (no-op).
Zero phUSD mint-debt accrues. No revert, no event. The condition persists silently until someone notices off-chain.
No backfill path exists to accrue the missed debt for the already-dispatched amounts.
recommendation: Make unwired dispatch fail loud and/or self-document: revert on unwired dispatch, or require(hook != address(0)) / assert a non-default hook in _dispatch (e.g. reject the DefaultDispatchHook sentinel for debt-bearing dispatchers). Additionally, fix the silently-passing integration test NudgeRatchet.t.sol:160-182 to call setHook and assert that phUSD mint-debt is accrued, so the unwired path can no longer pass the suite.
safeConfigGuidance: Operationally: always call dispatcher.setHook(nudgeHook) immediately after deploying NudgeRatchet+NudgeRatchetMintDebtHook and verify debt accrual before opening dispatches. Code fix preferred: revert on unwired dispatch or guard against the default sentinel hook in _dispatch, and update the integration test to assert debt accrual.
corroboratingSources: NudgeRatchet.t.sol:160-182 (integration test exercises path without setHook, asserts only USDC flow — passes silently)
